claim: David Lodge's Pen Test Partners disclosure was published 7 February 2022.
The unauthenticated map API took a parcel code and returned a PNG with the recipient address highlighted.
locator: TL;DR and The vulnerability, HTML lines 716–717 and 729–733
evidence: unauthenticated API call; map/route; PNG image
qualification: A valid package ID was needed; the record does not establish bulk enumeration.

claim: The researcher derived a postcode from street names visible in the map, including Verney Road and Queen Catherine Road.
qualification: This is the documented example, not proof that every map reveals a postcode.

claim: The tracking page asked for a postcode and used a transparent reCAPTCHA token; after the postcode was entered it displayed delivery information.
evidence: transparent reCAPTCHA token; postcode entered; standard information page
qualification: The article describes no separate login in this path.

claim: After the postcode check the session token gave access to underlying JSON containing recipient contact and parcel details.
evidence: session token; underlying JSON; contact and parcel details
qualification: The demonstrated disclosure depends on obtaining the postcode through the weak map gate.

claim: The archived JSON example shows a contactName and mobile field under notificationDetails while the email value is null.
evidence: contactName populated; mobile value redacted; email null
qualification: The screenshot does not support a claim that a populated email address was disclosed in this example.

claim: The disclosure timeline records initial email on 2 September, response on 30 September, confirmation on 1 October and resolution confirmation on 6 October 2021.
qualification: The article also gives inconsistent one-week and three-week duration summaries; use dated entries.

claim: DPD requested that publication be delayed until the new year while it reviewed the environment.
evidence: requested a delay in publishing until the new year
qualification: Researcher's account of DPD's request and stated reasons.
